activated.descr: whether the paired Guild has left draft; settings are re-validated on policy changes afterwards

activeBallots.descr: number of proposals with an open ballot

eligiblePower.descr: sum of all assigned signer weights

guild.descr: Guild permanently paired with this consensus application

maximumMemberWeight.descr: largest assigned weight; bounds the proposer power a Guild may require

membershipEpoch.descr: monotonic counter incremented by every membership change

membershipLocked.descr: whether membership changes have been permanently disabled

threshold.descr: approval power required for a proposal to pass

weightMode.descr: equal or explicitly assigned signer weighting

contract.name: FixedSignerGuildConsensus
contract.desc:
Allowlisted signer consensus with equal or explicitly assigned member weights.

All membership, threshold, and weight-mode administration happens through opaque Guild
consensus actions (`uint8 code || payload`, see ./constants.ts). The Guild kernel never
learns what those codes mean; it only routes them here and selects proposal settings.

methods.name: configure
methods.desc: Configure the initial member set through the paired Guild while it is in draft.

methods.name: consensusActionMbr
methods.desc: Quote and validate an opaque consensus action; unsupported codes are rejected.

methods.name: applyConsensusAction
methods.desc:
Apply an approved Guild consensus action; direct accounts cannot call this route.
The threshold is already bounded by total member power, so the proposal ID is unused.

methods.name: bindGuild
methods.desc: Permanently bind this consensus instance to the Guild created beside it.

methods.name: hasVoted
methods.desc: Whether `voter` has a vote on the proposal (a further vote changes it).
